title: Project architecture and migration
lead: Verified repository evidence, Paper2D + PaperZD presentation, planned domain owners and a safe path to native code.

title: 01 · Engineering philosophy
lead: Build the smallest correct solution that fits this game.

title: 02 · C++ and Blueprint responsibilities
lead: Choose implementation by ownership and variability, not by graph size alone.

title: 03 · Class design, composition and contracts
lead: Put each behavior near its authoritative state.

title: 04 · Enums and explicit state models
lead: Model one finite concept per enum and let one owner control transitions.

title: 05 · Data definitions, runtime values and identity
lead: A definition, owned instance and placed world source have different meanings.

title: 06 · Ownership and dependency direction
lead: Distinguish who stores a fact, who requests a change and who observes it.

title: 07 · Headers, source files and module organization
lead: Headers declare contracts; source files implement behavior.

title: 08 · Reflection and Blueprint API design
lead: Separate authoring, observation, commands and extension points.

title: 09 · Events, delegates and cross-system communication
lead: Commands request a change; events report completed facts.

title: 10 · Unreal object lifetime and memory
lead: Retention, gameplay ownership and persistence are different contracts.

title: 11 · Lifecycle and explicit initialization
lead: BeginPlay starts participation; readiness must be established deliberately.

title: 12 · Functions, control flow, naming and comments
lead: Make intent visible without clever expressions or redundant explanation.

title: 13 · Save-safe architecture and compatibility
lead: Persistent models are truth; SaveGame is a value snapshot.

title: 14 · Validation, errors, Tick and performance
lead: Choose explicit failure behavior and continuous work only where justified.

title: 15 · Testability and debugging
lead: Prove domain invariants and real Unreal integration with the smallest relevant checks.

title: 16 · Code review and Codex implementation rules
lead: Review ownership and compatibility before style.
